entries.f190a785652f2320: Aiming to become a technology group with high profitability, the company says it will strengthen development capabilities in fields with high growth potential, reduce unnecessary inventory and steadily pursue cost reductions. To strengthen its financial structure, the company will reduce inventory through improved operational efficiency, accelerate the collection of receivables, and shorten lead times and lower costs by improving yields. It will also work on extending its coating technology for liquid crystal applications to other markets and on proposing automotive components with high design value that apply printing technology.
